reviews.text: I love Ale and Alessio top..Guinness loves them
Always excellent! They love animals and it shows 🙏🏻

I've been trusting them for a few years now. Two years ago, I got a 3-month-old puppy from the shelter, so you can imagine how bad she looked and how bad she smelled. I'd let them know I'd bring her, but I didn't know the delivery time. They arrive by truck from the South.
As soon as I picked her up, I brought her, and they were fantastic.
When we went to pick her up, the little one was happy. She peed on a cushion where she'd been placed to test her leash twice. Alessandro, one of the owners, took her back down to wash her again.
My girls, there are three of them, and they're not small, and they're treated with all the love possible. One of them, Minny, is lame and needs to be handled very gently. Alessio, the other owner, is the only one I trust.
When my husband picks them up, he finds calm and happy dogs, they're carefully washed. I'm very critical and check everything. I think I'm Alessio's nightmare, but I love him because he knows how to treat girls, and it's important to me to see them happy.
I've never seen rude staff; Fausto is the guy who always looks after us.
Fantastic staff, always available.
The owners, Alessandro and Alessio, are wonderful people.

We've tried several salons in Milan, but this is undoubtedly the best. Super competent and professional. The prices are absolutely fair for the service. We entrusted our dog Gilda to them when she was a few months old, and we're still here. In addition to providing an excellent wash and cut (her dog comes back smelling great and soft as a teddy bear), they're fast and always take care of her well-being. Gilda is incredibly happy to come into the shop, and when we pick her up after treatment, she's calm and relaxed. Highly recommended!

Why can't I give zero stars? I bought a leash and harness for €300, and after a few weeks, the leash fell apart, while the harness remained intact. I called, they took it, and they said they had it regenerated. After a week, it started falling apart again, and the skin even peeled off. I called back, and they said they'd been using theirs for years and it was fine. Note that it was for a 3 kg fox. They arrogantly dismissed us... a terrible experience.

We visited this store on December 18, 2024, we did grooming for the dog and purchased a jacket. The staff knew that we were leaving Milan the same day because we informed them in advance.
Before leaving the store, we confirmed the soze with a man who helped us choose a jacket. Our dog was with us, and we checked whether the size was right. However, after leaving Milan, we discovered that we had been given a jacket in the wrong size.
We contacted the store immediately. We explained that we did not know when we would be able to return to Milan and that it might be one or even two years later because we live abroad. The store assured us that this would not be a problem. We then asked them to confirm this in writing so that we would have a record of our agreement. They subsequently sent us a message stating that the jacket could be exchanged when we returned to Milan. Relying on that written confirmation, we did not request an immediate refund.
We kept the jacket in its original packaging, unused, while waiting for the opportunity to return to Milan and exchange it, as we had been instructed by the store.
One year and six months later, before traveling to Milan, we contacted the store again. They either gave very brief responses or ignored our messages altogether. I then called the store and asked to speak with the manager. The person who answered the phone told me that the manager was unavailable and would call me back. However, we never received a callback.
After we returned to Milan, the store refused to exchange the jacket. During our communications, different reasons were given for the refusal. Initially, we were told that too much time had passed. We were also told that the issue was related to the dog’s growth. Later, the store stated that it could not offer an exchange because it no longer carried that brand.
We have retained screenshots of our correspondence, proof of purchase, bank payment records, and other documents supporting the events described in this review
In our opinion, if the store intended to apply a specific time limit, this should have been communicated when we first contacted them, rather than assuring us that the exchange could be made when we returned to Milan. Had we been informed of such a limitation, we would have requested a refund immediately after discovering the mistake.
This review reflects our personal experience with this store. Based on that experience, we were disappointed by the way our case was handled and believe that the communication we received was inconsistent with the store’s later position. We have screenshots, written correspondence, and other evidence supporting our account.
Today I took Bella, my Pomeranian, for a summer haircut, preserving her fur to avoid alopecia. I had a great experience and will continue to bring her here. I highly recommend it!

Beautiful place, a dog boutique with a wide selection of quality accessories. Clean and well-kept environment, and very welcoming and knowledgeable staff. They washed and groomed my rescued Pomeranian with great care, doing an extraordinary job. My skin and coat are so thankful, and so is my little one, who was reborn. See you next time! Maverick and family

I took my 3 and a half month old poodle for her first grooming. The staff was very kind and very affectionate towards my dog, and what can I say? When I went to pick her up, she was even more beautiful, she looked like a teddy bear.
Well done, really well done
Professionalism and kindness...which together create a place where you feel at home...and the little ones, even if they arrive scared, relax immediately. Thanks from your Savannah

Highly recommended shop. I had a very positive experience with the purchase and, above all, with the after-sales service. I received very professional and courteous treatment, rare these days. Even though I'm from Aosta, they definitely acquired a long-distance customer. Thanks again for all the attention you've shown me.
See you soon!
Leopoldo the dachshund, thank you too!
We brought our poodle Dolly for the first time, she came out of Ukkia a Star, really good, kind and capable

I took my Maltese Mia for the first time yesterday and was very pleased. A perfect cut, short as I asked. Congratulations on the job! The staff were professional and very kind!
I'll definitely be back!!!

I've been taking my Brigitta to Ukkia since her first bath. What can I say?!? Professionalism, kindness, friendliness, and so much passion!! Besides coming out gorgeous after every grooming session (complete with a bow and an incredible scent), my little girl is calm and happy.
Thank you guys!!! You are incredible!!!!!

Quality and passion are everything, and when it comes to my furry friends, I accept no compromises. That's why I say it out loud: Ukkia Corso Vercelli is the absolute best! 🐾 It's not just a question of aesthetics (even if they come home looking like they just stepped out of a fashion show!), but it's the way they treat animals: with a kindness, patience, and respect I've rarely seen elsewhere. You can tell from a mile away that they're driven by a visceral love for what they do. For me, they're the new absolute number one for grooming in Milan. If you're looking for professionalism combined with a big heart like this, look no further. My friends are the best, and your pups will thank me!
Thank you guys, you're pure energy and expertise. 5 stars aren't enough! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐"
The staff was amazing, everyone was so kind, and the Adian style they did for my Nespolina was beautiful. Thank you so much.
Top grooming in Milan!

Truly gorgeous!! I took my 12 year old Chery to this shop. My friend Chiara, Pepe's mother, recommended it to me... When they brought her to me, she looked like another dog... she looked like a puppy... I was actually moved... No groomer has ever given me a haircut like this... even when you stroke her fur, it's so soft!!! My compliments to all the staff who work there!!!
A true boutique for our four-legged friends. 🐾 …
They were able to handle our Otto with his sweet personality and did a fantastic job with his fur. Thank you!
They're selling expired biscuits!
Always ask to see and accompany your dog downstairs where the grooming takes place!

I’ve been taking Toffee, my male Shihtzu, to Ukkia since it opened in Corso Vercelli and I’m very happy with the results. Oksana always does an excellent job of bathing and trimming Toffee and he leaves the shop looking so beautiful. The staff members are super sweet and helpful, and there’s a good choice of top quality products. Highly recommend!👍👍🫶🐶

MONEY HAS VALUE!!!
I'm a regular customer, or rather, I was, because after this experience, they won't see me again. A week ago, I brought my toy poodle in for a wash and grooming (€75). When it was picked up by a person I'd appointed and I saw the result that evening, I promptly called the next day to explain that the haircut had been done poorly (the head was shaved, making it smaller than the body hair, only a few mm shorter). Furthermore, the entire belly and private parts hadn't been shaved properly. The person on the phone told me to bring it back the following week and they'd take care of it, and they did. When I brought it back, they actually admitted that the haircut hadn't been done properly. It's a shame that after the new haircut, they had the nerve to ask me for another €75 for the service, and after I complained, they lowered it to €50. I find this behavior deeply unfair. I spent a total of €125, with the result that they'll never see me again, and I won't recommend this shop to anyone. I remind the owners (as a former shopkeeper) that success for a business isn't just about making money, but also knowing how to hold on to customers. The downturns always come sooner or later, and you only survive with loyal customers. Eduardo.

The staff were attentive and very helpful. There were only a couple of things I didn't really appreciate, but I can overlook them given that the grooming results were good. The first was that I was told I would be charged a premium (over the phone when I booked), but then I ended up paying about €30 more. The second was that there were some longer hairs on one of my paws when I picked them up, but they promptly trimmed it, so no complaints. Overall, I was happy with the service; they seemed to be very good with my puppy, and I'm also happy with the end result. So I plan on returning.
Beatiful place, very detailed and well taken care in any part of it. Extremely clean and a very very friendly staff. Highly recommended.
kind and competent

Good evening, I wanted to thank you for making my little prince gorgeous!!! He's a real walking "business card"!!! Everyone asks me where he was groomed!!! Congratulations!!! Your kindness and professionalism make the real difference!!!

Yesterday I took my Maltese for the first time. I was very pleased; when I came back to pick him up, he was perfectly groomed and, above all, relaxed and calm. I can only be satisfied with the professionalism and kindness.
Top !

Today, for the first time, I took my poodle to Ukkia, a groomer I discovered thanks to Valeria Di Grazia, whom I follow and admire for her fantastic advice.
At Ukkia, when you walk in, you immediately feel welcomed and immersed in an animal paradise. They have excellent quality products, and all the staff are welcoming and helpful.
Today, Muffin had a teddy bear cut. Every detail was taken care of by the dedicated groomer, achieving an excellent result. ❤️
Valeria was incredibly kind. If it weren't for her, I wouldn't have known about this special shop!
Thank you, Valeria 💜
Thanks to Ukkia 🙏🏻❤️
Beautiful shop, professionalism and friendliness

What can I say... more than satisfied not only with the professionalism and price but also with the great sensitivity and empathy I found. A special thanks to Oxana for the cut and to Valeria for the advice, support, and for looking after my Bibi ♥️ even though we live in another province, we will be back ♥️

Even understanding the position, even understanding the market, even understanding that quality comes at a price, whatever you want, but finding birthday "cakes" (which are actually large circular biscuits) for 25 euros when you can find them for 13 at the hypermarket....with all the good will in the world, I find the price increase quite unacceptable.
